TITLE: Programme document
loadError: The programme document could not be loaded
deleteText: This version of the document is deleted for good, with all its content. The other versions stay.
revised: A draft of the new version was created
cancelText: The generation stops at its next step. AI costs already incurred are not refunded.
readOnly: An approved document is not changed any more. To change it, create a new version.

APPROVAL.title: Approve the document?
APPROVAL.text: By approving you state that you reviewed the document and that it is fit for use. An approved document is not changed any more — a change is made as a new version.
APPROVAL.blocked: It cannot be approved while a blocking rule is broken.
APPROVAL.unsavedFirst: Save or discard the changes first.

RULES.title: Rules
RULES.hint: The rules a document of this kind must keep. A broken blocking rule keeps it from approval; a note is only a warning to the reviewer.
RULES.blocked: The document cannot be approved: {count} blocking rule(s) broken.
RULES.allKept: Every blocking rule is kept — the document can be approved.
RULES.stale: The rules are checked again when you save the changes.

NAMES.parts: All eight parts of the policy are written
NAMES.provisions: The articles named are in their acts
NAMES.provisions_unverified: The acts named are in the legal corpus
NAMES.provision_subjects: The provisions named regulate what they are named for
NAMES.quotes: The quotes stand in the documents they name
NAMES.hierarchy: Every document of the company is placed on a level
NAMES.structure: The structure is a tree under a governing body
NAMES.independence: The second line is not under the first; internal audit reports to a governing body alone
NAMES.process: The process has at least five steps
NAMES.raci_accountable: Every step has exactly one accountable role (A)
NAMES.raci_responsible: Every step has at least one responsible role (R)
NAMES.raci_everywhere: No role takes part in every step
NAMES.raci_heavy: No role is accountable for more than half of the steps
NAMES.process_basis: Every step rests on a known clause of ISO 37301 or paragraph of the guidelines
NAMES.criteria: The criteria tables, the risk appetite and how they were fitted are filled in
NAMES.scenarios: There are at least five risk scenarios
NAMES.categories: The scenarios cover at least four types of legal risk
NAMES.sentence: Every scenario has all four parts of its sentence
NAMES.ties: Every scenario is tied to a unit and an internal policy
NAMES.scores: Every score is on the scale of 1 to 5
NAMES.owners: Every scenario has an owner and a deadline
NAMES.response_fit: The response fits the risk level
NAMES.sentence_form: The scenario's sentence keeps the set form

PROVISION.open: Open the official text of “{label}” (new tab)
PROVISION.actHint: Write the act's short title, e.g. MiCA, DORA, PPTFPĮ.
PROVISION.pending: to be looked up on save

FLAG.not_found: The act has no such provision
FLAG.act_not_in_corpus: The act is not in the corpus — the reference was not checked

PROGRESS.title: The document is being generated
PROGRESS.queued: The generation is queued — it starts when a worker is free.
PROGRESS.running: You can leave this page — the generation goes on in the background and the draft is saved.
PROGRESS.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested — the generation stops at its next step.
PROGRESS.stepsHidden: The steps' durations and cost are visible only to the user who started the generation.

ENDED.failedText: The document could not be generated. You can generate it again.
ENDED.cancelledText: The generation was stopped before it finished. You can generate it again.

POLICY.decisions: For the governing body to decide
POLICY.textHint: Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

DOCUMENTS.hierarchyHint: Every document of the company is placed on a level.
DOCUMENTS.missingHint: The second- and third-level documents the company lacks for the policy to work.
DOCUMENTS.title: Title

GOVERNANCE.chartAlt: Chart of the governance structure; the table under it lists the same nodes.
GOVERNANCE.chartFailed: The chart of the structure could not be loaded
GOVERNANCE.chartStale: The chart is drawn again when you save the changes.
GOVERNANCE.nodesHint: Bodies, committees, functions and units by the three lines model.
GOVERNANCE.name: Name
GOVERNANCE.raciKey: R — responsible, A — accountable, AR — both, C — consulted, I — informed
GOVERNANCE.goldenAccountable: Exactly one accountable role (A) is needed — there are {count} now.
GOVERNANCE.goldenResponsible: At least one responsible role (R) is needed.
GOVERNANCE.positions: Positions and units the documents name

RISKS.matrixCaption: Impact in the rows, likelihood in the columns. A cell shows its score and the scenarios that fall in it.
RISKS.pending: Placed in a cell on save: {ids}
RISKS.scorePending: The risk level is worked out on save
RISKS.typesHint: One or two types, by ISO 31022.
RISKS.typesMax: No more than two types can be chosen — take one out first.
RISKS.policiesHint: The company's documents the scenario concerns — at least one.
RISKS.sentenceHint: Form: “A likely [event], arising from [source], may cause [consequences] that affect [objective].”

DIMENSIONS.counterparty: Reliability of counterparties and third parties

PROVENANCE.title: Provenance
PROVENANCE.hint: What the document was made from and how — so the result can be traced.
PROVENANCE.noProducts: It builds on no other programme document.
PROVENANCE.revisedFrom: The approved version this draft was made from
PROVENANCE.noPrompts: No model was called for this version.

REFUSALS.NO_DOCUMENTS: The company has no readable documents — upload them first.
REFUSALS.ALREADY_RUNNING: This document is already being generated.
REFUSALS.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Today's AI usage budget is spent. Try again tomorrow.
REFUSALS.RULES_BROKEN: The draft breaks blocking rules — mend it and try again.
REFUSALS.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be edited or approved.
REFUSALS.NOT_APPROVED: A new version is made only from an approved document.
REFUSALS.NEWER_VERSION: A newer version of this document is already in work.
REFUSALS.NOT_CANCELLABLE: The generation can no longer be stopped — it has already ended.
REFUSALS.NOT_READY: Only a draft or an approved document can be downloaded.
